newsitem.title: USA: Dow index up more than 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow index up more than 100 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 100 points in mid-afternoon trading Tuesday, buoyed by a jump in bonds following Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's comments about the economy.

At 2:10 p.m. EDT, the Dow was up 100.81 points at 8,007.53. The yield on the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond fell below 6.50 percent on Greenspan's statement to Congress that the economy was slowing.
